instructions: Prioritize production correctness over style. For this docs repo, focus on link integrity, canonical URL usage, discoverability artifacts (llms.txt, llms-full.txt, sitemap), and CI safety. Flag stale/broken links, duplicated low-signal sections, and weak validation that allows malformed llms.txt to pass.

rules.rule: Ensure high-signal curation: no duplicated URLs, no dead links, no broad unstructured dumping of low-value pages.
Validator must fail closed on malformed input and must verify URL format, section structure, and local path mapping.
Workflows must use least-privilege permissions and avoid unsafe action pinning practices.
